clue.text: Continent priest taken in by first-class accountant

indicators.note: something taken in by another is held inside it, so the priest's abbreviation sits within the first-class letters

parts.note: A1 means first-class, written AI in crosswords
Fr is the abbreviation for Father, a priest
CA is a chartered accountant

explanation.surface: A clergyman somewhere on a continent is taken under the wing of a top-notch accountant.
explanation.definitionFit: Africa is one of the world's great landmasses, an example of a continent.

clue.text: Hold a demonstration in support of international cricket

parts.note: pro means for, in support of
a Test is a full international cricket match

explanation.surface: Fans rally behind their national cricket side with a march.
explanation.walkthrough: A Test match is international cricket played between national sides over several days.
explanation.definitionFit: To protest is to march or rally against something, i.e. to stage a demonstration.

clue.text: It keeps locks in good order

definitions.text: It keeps locks in good order

parts.words: It keeps locks in good order
parts.note: the surface suggests a locksmith or canal keeper maintaining locks; the locks are tresses of hair kept tidy by a grooming tool

explanation.definitionFit: A grooming tool with bristles keeps tresses tidy, and locks are tresses.

clue.text: Fixes lighting in the Civil Service

indicators.note: in places the lighting word inside the abbreviation for the Civil Service

parts.note: CS is the abbreviation for the Civil Service
a lamp provides lighting

explanation.surface: A government department repairs its office lights.
explanation.definitionFit: Clamps are devices or actions that fasten things firmly, as fixes do (verb sense: secures).

clue.text: The French examination is completely up-to date

parts.note: la is French for 'the' (feminine)
a test is an examination

explanation.surface: The French exam is right up with the times.
explanation.definitionFit: The newest thing is fully current, so most recent equals completely modern.

clue.text: The letter is certainly not from a seaman

definitions.text: The letter is certainly not from a seaman

parts.words: The letter is certainly not from a seaman
parts.note: a letter here is one who lets rooms; the woman doing so is a figure of the land rather than of the sea, a female of the shore rather than a sailor

explanation.definitionFit: A woman who lets rooms is a 'letter', and her title contrasts land with sea and lady with man.

clue.text: Mean to get drunk

explanation.surface: Someone stingy decides to go off and get sloshed.
explanation.definitionFit: Tight describes a miserly person who hates spending, and is also slang for being intoxicated.

clue.text: Looking intently around the lake to see a bird

indicators.note: around has the staring word wrapping the lake's letter

parts.note: staring is looking intently
L is the abbreviation for lake

explanation.surface: Gazing across a lake, a birdwatcher hopes to spot something feathered.
explanation.definitionFit: The starling is a common speckled songbird, an example of a bird.

clue.text: Class-mate with a punctilious manner

parts.note: a form is a school class
an ally is a friend or mate

explanation.surface: A schoolfellow who behaves with great correctness.
explanation.walkthrough: In British schools a class is called a form.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting punctiliously means observing etiquette and rules, which is doing things in an official, correct way.

clue.text: A ragman, for example!

parts.note: the phrase looks like a rag-and-bone dealer offered as a sample, but its seven letters rearranged spell the very word it illustrates, a word-game self-reference

explanation.definitionFit: Rearranging the letters of 'a ragman' gives a word made by reshuffling, so the phrase is an example of such letter play.

clue.text: Put in a grave order for some plain terracotta

indicators.note: some says the answer is a run of letters hidden inside the words that follow

parts.note: the letters run across the end of one word into the next

explanation.surface: Someone requests a burial in a simple clay pot.
explanation.definitionFit: To bury a body is to lay it to rest in a tomb; 'order' completes the instruction to bury.

clue.text: Collection of stamps taken from a Greek letter recently

parts.note: phi is the 21st letter of the Greek alphabet
lately means recently

explanation.surface: A stamp album acquired from a Greek correspondent not long ago.
explanation.definitionFit: Philately is the hobby of collecting and studying postage stamps.

clue.text: Run after a man and woman

indicators.note: after places the run abbreviation behind the man's pronoun

parts.note: he is the pronoun for a man
R is the cricket abbreviation for run

explanation.surface: Someone chases after a couple.
explanation.definitionFit: The pronoun used for a female person stands for a woman.

clue.text: Difficult to understand how Jack gets a virtuous man to cheat

parts.note: a jack is a sailor, as is an AB (able seaman)
ST is short for saint, a virtuous man
a ruse is a trick or cheat

explanation.surface: A tangled tale of a sailor tempting a holy man into deceit.
explanation.definitionFit: Abstruse means obscure and recondite, hard to grasp.

clue.text: Challenging American lawman to make a call

parts.note: a DA is a US district attorney
to ring is to call on the telephone

explanation.surface: A US prosecutor phones in a dare.
explanation.definitionFit: Daring means bold and defiant, as is a challenging act.

clue.text: From a range of English hills to mountains in Italy

parts.note: the Pennines are the upland chain running down northern England

explanation.surface: A journey from northern English uplands to the Italian peaks.
explanation.walkthrough: The Pennines, the 'backbone of England', are a range of hills in the north of England.
explanation.definitionFit: The Apennines are the range forming the spine of the Italian peninsula.

clue.text: Appeals are permissible in a distress-signal

indicators.note: in puts the permissible word inside the distress call

parts.note: SOS is the Morse distress signal
licit means lawful, permissible

explanation.surface: Calls for help are allowed when sent as an emergency signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Solicits as a verb means asks for or requests earnestly, as one who appeals does.

clue.text: Saying what a feller needs

definitions.meaning: a feller is one who fells trees, and needs a cutting tool

explanation.surface: A bit of folk wisdom about what a chap requires.
explanation.definitionFit: A saw is an old proverb or maxim, and also the toothed tool a woodcutter uses to fell trees.

clue.text: A Spartan adversary of old

parts.note: reads as an austere old enemy, but means a citizen of the city state that warred with Sparta in ancient Greece

explanation.walkthrough: 'Spartan' looks like an adjective (austere) but refers to Sparta, whose great rival was Athens in the Peloponnesian War.
explanation.definitionFit: Citizens of Athens fought Sparta in the Peloponnesian War, making them its classical foes.

clue.text: Swindle a college servant

definitions.meaning: a manservant attending students at certain university colleges

explanation.surface: A college porter is caught cheating someone.
explanation.walkthrough: At Cambridge and Durham universities a college servant is traditionally called a gyp.
explanation.definitionFit: Gyp is slang for cheat, and is also the name for a servant at Cambridge and Durham colleges.

clue.text: The first of the books has to be purchased

indicators.note: the first of picks the opening letter of the following word

parts.note: ought means is obliged to, has to

explanation.surface: The opening volume of a series must be bought.
explanation.definitionFit: Something bought has been acquired by paying, i.e. purchased.

clue.text: Son meets the old man in Spring

parts.note: pa is father, colloquially the old man

explanation.surface: A boy meets his father one day in springtime.
explanation.definitionFit: A spa is a mineral spring, or a resort built round one.

clue.text: The communication I have with a young lady

parts.note: miss is a title for a young unmarried woman
I've is the contraction of I have

explanation.surface: A man mentions the letter he exchanged with a girl.
explanation.definitionFit: A missive is a letter or written message, a form of communication.

clue.text: I come in out of breath when decorating

indicators.note: come in has the I enter the breathless word

parts.note: panting means gasping, out of breath

explanation.surface: A decorator arrives gasping from the effort of the job.
explanation.definitionFit: Applying paint to walls is what decorating a room involves.

clue.text: He has a line on Pythagoras, perhaps

definitions.text: He has a line on Pythagoras, perhaps

parts.words: He has a line on Pythagoras, perhaps
parts.note: a fisherman has a line; and a geometer such as the Greek mathematician might be called one who works with triangles' corners, a person who has a line on them

explanation.definitionFit: A fisherman casts a line, and a student of corners like Pythagoras could jokingly be called one too.

clue.text: Eager for former prime minister to retain possession of limited edition

indicators.note: to retain possession of means the minister's name holds the edition abbreviation inside it

parts.note: Earl Grey was British prime minister 1830-34
ed is a cut-down (limited) form of edition

explanation.surface: A past premier is keen to keep hold of a rare printed edition.
explanation.walkthrough: Earl Grey (the tea is named after him) was a 19th-century British prime minister.
explanation.definitionFit: Greedy can mean keenly desirous, as in greedy for knowledge, which is to say eager.

clue.text: General Tom Thumb fought in the American War of Independence

definitions.meaning: the stage name of a famously tiny circus performer, read as a minute (tiny) man

definitions.text: fought in the American War of Independence
definitions.meaning: an American colonial militiaman ready to fight at short notice

explanation.surface: A tiny circus celebrity supposedly served in the American Revolution.
explanation.definitionFit: The tiny showman General Tom Thumb was literally a very small man, and colonial militiamen ready at a moment's notice fought the British.

clue.text: Subscription for international organisation is excessive

parts.note: UN is the United Nations
a due is a membership fee or subscription

explanation.surface: The fee charged for a world body is too high.
explanation.definitionFit: Undue means unwarranted or more than is fitting, i.e. excessive.

clue.text: A publication for children

definitions.meaning: one edition of a magazine or newspaper

explanation.surface: A magazine for youngsters.
explanation.definitionFit: An issue is one edition of a magazine, and in law one's issue are one's offspring.

clue.text: Show contempt when Dad is in trouble

indicators.note: being in trouble suggests these letters are disordered and need rearranging

explanation.surface: Someone sneers when their father gets into a fix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in trouble' looks like one phrase, but 'in' is fodder and 'trouble' alone signals the anagram of DAD IS IN.
explanation.definitionFit: To disdain is to scorn or look down on, a verb of contempt.

clue.text: Kept quiet

definitions.meaning: held back, set aside for later

explanation.definitionFit: Reserved means set aside for someone (booked) and also describes a reticent, undemonstrative person.

clue.text: Like a sea-bird over the rear of the ship

definitions.text: over the rear of the ship

parts.note: as means like
a tern is a sea-bird

explanation.surface: A gull-like bird hovers above the back of a vessel.
explanation.definitionFit: Astern means at or towards the back of a vessel, behind it.
